# Design — POST /v1/loans/{id}/transfer DTO contract

## L1 invariant

Every externally-deserialized DTO MUST carry `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]`. A client typo (`amunt` for `amount`) MUST fail deserialization, never silently default. PII fields MUST NOT appear in `Debug` / `Display` output without redaction.

## Public contract

- Route: `POST /v1/loans/:id/transfer`
- Request body: `TransferDto { from: AccountId, to: AccountId, amount_cents: i64, customer_email: String }`
- `customer_email` is PII — MUST be redacted in logs / errors.

## Convention notes

- Validation crate: `validator` OR hand-rolled `TryFrom<RawDto>` (this PR uses validator).
- All DTOs use `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]` consistently.
